scope: Four assigned India targets in the next-ten unresolved cohort; WUP target labels and points retained.

cityFiles.name: Bengaluru
cityFiles.technicalBlocker: No geometry was obtained. Escalated ordinary GET attempts to the official Dishaank, Karnataka BhoomiMaps, KSRSAC and GBA GIS Viewer routes all ended in ConnectTimeout before HTTP response. The search-indexed GBA viewer exposes admin selectors; the official GEPTIS public view requires mobile-linked registration. These are specific access/interface findings, not evidence that no Karnataka data exists.

cityFiles.name: Chennai
cityFiles.technicalBlocker: No Chennai parcel polygon was obtained. The official eServices/TNGIS/CMDA application routes timed out before HTTP response; live GCC public GIS metadata exposes road and administrative boundaries, and the exact WUP point resolves only to ward 136. The public GCCPropertyTax folder listing is empty, while a separate GCCWebAppPublic folder explicitly requires a token.

cityFiles.name: Hyderabad
cityFiles.technicalBlocker: Public TGRAC endpoint at the WUP coordinate returns one aggregate GHMC polygon, with blank Parcel_num and a “to be checked” remark; the ULB cadastral and cadastral point queries return zero features.

cityFiles.name: Ghatkesar
cityFiles.technicalBlocker: Nine app cells yielded 37 nonblank survey numbers; fresh exact native-ID counts, manifests and geometries timed out at 15 seconds. The source also supports ESRI JSON/AMF only, while the current adapter requires GeoJSON. Three blank-ID Road/Village boundary rows are an explicit omitted-subset candidate, not parcel identities.

notes: Ghatkesar sample is independently verified at the exact WUP coordinate; full adapter acceptance is owned by the separate west/south worker.
Bengaluru and Chennai remain temporary endpoint/access blockers; Hyderabad official state service returned only aggregate administrative geometry at the exact WUP point.
No citywide or statewide completeness is claimed.
